NAM.1.1-1.text: The book of Nahum’s vision against Nineveh

NAM.1.2-3.text: The LORD punishes his enemies but is slow to anger

NAM.1.4-5.text: The LORD’s power shakes the sea, mountains and earth

NAM.1.6-6.text: No one can stand before the LORD’s burning anger

NAM.1.7-8.text: The LORD protects those who trust him and ends Nineveh

NAM.1.9-11.text: The LORD will end the evil plots of Nineveh

NAM.1.12-13.text: The LORD promises to free Judah from Nineveh’s yoke

NAM.1.14-14.text: The LORD commands that Nineveh will have no descendants

NAM.1.15-15.text: Good news for Judah: the wicked will be cut off

NAM.2.1-2.text: An enemy attacks Nineveh and the LORD restores Jacob

NAM.2.3-4.text: Red-clad warriors and chariots rush through the city

NAM.2.5-5.text: The attackers rush to Nineveh’s wall

NAM.2.6-7.text: The river gates open and Nineveh’s palace falls

NAM.2.8-10.text: Nineveh is emptied, plundered and laid waste

NAM.2.11-12.text: Where is Nineveh, the lions’ den full of prey?

NAM.2.13-13.text: The LORD declares that he is against Nineveh

NAM.3.1-2.text: Woe to Nineveh, the city of blood and lies

NAM.3.3-4.text: Nineveh’s war and witchcraft leave many dead

NAM.3.5-7.text: The LORD will shame Nineveh before the nations

NAM.3.8-9.text: Nineveh is no better than Thebes, which also fell

NAM.3.10-11.text: Thebes went into exile, and Nineveh will also fall

NAM.3.12-13.text: Nineveh’s fortresses and troops will fall to enemies

NAM.3.14-15.text: Nineveh’s defenses will not save it from fire and sword

NAM.3.16-17.text: Nineveh’s merchants and guards will vanish like locusts

NAM.3.18-19.text: Assyria’s king falls, and all who hear applaud
